description: Human-labelled calibration set for the code-review judge (item 2 of the subagent-eval-calibration backlog: 'a judge-vs-human calibration loop with BLOCK thresholds'). Each entry pins a recorded result JSON (the judge INPUT, frozen offline) plus the score a human assigned to each JUDGE-kind dimension on that exact output, in [0,1]. scripts/dev/agent-eval-calibrate.py runs the judge command over each entry's recorded trial output and BLOCKS (exit 1) when |judge - human| exceeds the calibration policy's max_divergence (mean or any-single, per policy). Objective dimensions are excluded — they are deterministic code checks with no judge to calibrate. Re-label off-CI by a human when a new smoke is recorded; keep the corpus small + real (anchored to real cases).
